name: 整列頁首＋標誌左、導覽右，滑過展開子連結，捲動後出現底板
desc: 橫跨全寬、固定在畫面頂端的頁首。標誌在左，導覽連結和功能區靠右，內容延伸到接近畫面左右邊緣；有子項目的連結滑過後往下展開一欄子連結；捲過主視覺後頁首出現底板與下緣分隔線。手機版收成全螢幕選單。
prompt: 建立一個橫跨整個畫面寬的頁首列，固定在畫面頂端：標誌在左，導覽連結與功能區靠右，所有元素在同一水平線上垂直置中；內容不受頁面內容寬度限制，左右延伸到接近畫面邊緣，只留少許邊距。功能區可放一個圖示按鈕與一個主要按鈕，沒有時省略。有子項目的導覽項目旁有一個展開符號；導覽項目有子項目時，滑過後在該項目下方展開一欄子連結。捲過主視覺後頁首出現底板，並在頁首下緣出現一條分隔線；往下或往上捲動都不隱藏，高度不變。
mobile: 頁首仍是整列，頁首上只留標誌在左、選單按鈕在右，導覽連結與功能區都收進選單面板。點選單按鈕後，展開蓋住整個畫面的選單面板，選單按鈕變成關閉按鈕；面板裡的導覽連結靠左、明顯大於其他文字，分成兩欄直向排列；下方放功能區的主要按鈕，再下方一條橫向分隔線，分隔線下方可放一欄小型文字連結與一個小圖示連結，沒有時省略；有子項目時點擊後在原位展開。固定在畫面頂端、捲過主視覺後出現底板的行為保留。

en.name: Full-width header bar + logo left, navigation right, hover dropdown, gains a background panel after scrolling
en.desc: A full-width header fixed to the top of the viewport. The logo is on the left, with the navigation links and the actions group on the right, extending close to the left and right edges of the viewport; links with sub-items open a column of sub-links below on hover; after scrolling past the hero the header gains a background panel and a divider appears along the bottom edge. On mobile the navigation moves into a full-screen menu.
en.prompt: Create a header bar spanning the full width of the viewport, fixed to the top of the viewport, with the logo on the left, with the navigation links and the actions group on the right, all elements vertically centered on the same horizontal line; the content is not limited to the page content width and extends close to the left and right edges of the viewport, keeping only a small margin. Optionally place one icon button and one primary button in the actions group; omit them when there is no content. Navigation items that have sub-items show an expand symbol next to them; when a navigation item has sub-items, hovering over it opens a single column of sub-links below that item. After scrolling past the hero, the header gains a background panel and a divider appears along the bottom edge of the header; the header never hides, whether scrolling down or up, and its height does not change.
en.mobile: The header stays a full-width bar, keeping only the logo on the left and the menu button on the right; the navigation links and the actions group move into the menu panel. Tapping the menu button opens a menu panel covering the entire viewport, and the menu button turns into a close button; in the panel the navigation links are left-aligned, clearly larger than the other text, and arranged vertically in two columns; below them sits the primary button from the actions group, then a horizontal divider, and below the divider you may place a single column of small text links and one small icon link, omitted when there is no content; items with sub-items expand in place when tapped. The header stays fixed to the top of the viewport and still gains a background panel after scrolling past the hero.
